posts.title: Botsitting: the work we don’t count
posts.description: Our new paper in the Journal of Computer Information Systems examines botsitting: the often unrecognised human labour involved in verifying, correcting and contextualising AI outputs, and what this work means for organisational productivity, professional judgement and the oversight of increasingly autonomous systems.

posts.title: Mobile phones in schools in Wales: have your say
posts.description: The Welsh Government is consulting on draft guidance to restrict mobile phone use in schools. Drawing on my previous curriculum work in Wales, I’m encouraging learners, families, education practitioners and others with relevant experience to respond by 2 December.

posts.title: A voice that stayed with me: Patrick Stewart and Jean-Luc Picard
posts.description: Remembering Sir Patrick Stewart, whose portrayal of Jean-Luc Picard helped shape how I think about science, culture, evidence and leadership, and the importance of learning from mistakes, accepting challenge and being willing to change our minds.
